built_pages_note: Measured 2026-09-06 (paper lap 10) by paper/measure_pages.py: 22 pages under Carlito, page objects and page-tree /Count agreeing, gated by check_paper.py against the author's 25-page rule (NH-028). Three pages of margin. It was 21 at lap 9; the page went to the ~1,100 words of the new SS4.5 (the fair opponent). The section's figure, F9_present_perimeter, is drawn and committed but NOT referenced by the manuscript - the lap reviewer blocked it because its bar totals plus Table 2 determined the margin NH-032 bars from judge-facing surfaces (paper/GAPS.md, gap G8) - so it costs no page here and will cost one when NH-032 is answered and it is referenced. THE FACE IS PART OF THE NUMBER: metric-compatible Carlito stands in for the non-redistributable Calibri build_docx.py asks for, so the gate reports and falls back to the 9,000-word proxy on any face whose metrics are not Calibri's. built_pages_inputs is the WFG-116 anchor: the digest of the document this 22 was measured on (the ordered figure list with pixel sizes, the table and reference counts, the body-word count). It does NOT re-derive the page count and nothing in this file does. Set both fields to null rather than hand-writing an anchor no run produced. WFG-116's other half, an apt line in auto-gates.yml so a clean clone measures, is open and outside paper/.
